title: Contam Path Map
description: ContamX path_map.json entries: the seven-key writer contract plus optional filtered/sink/declared_flow_m3h fields.

kind.description: Path class. 'ambient_opening' is a declared two-way opening authored zone -> ambient (positive solved flow is outward), distinct from the 'envelope_leak' pressure reference.

filtered.description: Optional P-min carry-through: present only when the resolved link filtration differs from the deprecated is_hvac_ducted alias. Absent resolves to is_hvac_ducted.

sink.description: Optional exhaust-sink marker: when true the ContamX lane treats a positive solved flow as outflow-only from from_zone; absent means an ordinary room/ambient endpoint.

declared_flow_m3h.description: Optional commissioned-mode declared branch flow recorded beside the solved field.
